description: Prices the ENTIRE declared freedom of the corpus's nucleon-element recipe against Q_beta at the ruled functional (tr at z_D): 8 quark-generator assignments x 2 Hopf orientations, and within each every ordering of the 11 letters. Reports how many configurations reach Q_beta within experimental error. Names no configuration; scope-(a).

data.markov_convention: D — the ruled functional, z_D = q^3/(q^2+1)

caveats: Scope-(a). Prices the freedom the SOURCE BLOCKS declare — the 16 readings the census already flags, plus ordering. It does not enumerate arbitrary multisets and does not exclude Option E: an element derived from somewhere other than this recipe is outside it.

Names no configuration. A configuration exhibited because it lands on Q_beta would be selection against the target — a fit under AGENTS.md NO FITTING — which is exactly why the useful output is a COUNT rather than a candidate.

The readings are PAIRED: gens/hopf is one recipe, so the same assignment applies to both nucleons, as the census's constructed_variants does. Pairing a proton reading with a different neutron reading would be a 17th choice nobody has made.
